hold_reason: Refund discrepancy: Alpha Co's handoff reports refunds for order 192 (3148 cents), 193 (9581 cents), and 194 (5972 cents) as applied, but list_refunds shows only 192 and 193. Order 194's refund of 5972 cents is not in the shared ledger, so net balances for that customer may be overstated. No payouts have been recorded. Needs confirmation from Alpha Co/W2 that refund 194 was applied, or correction, before payouts proceed.

reply.thought: Alpha Co's handoff says refunds are applied, but I should check the ledger before paying anyone. Listing the refunds first.
